answer: Dispute bounty with slashing. Each identity locks 50 POA for 60 days. Anyone can accuse an identity of being a duplicate by posting a 20 POA bond, and 5 random peers review the evidence. A proven fake loses its stake and the accuser takes 60 percent. Cost of 1 fake is 50 POA, 10 fakes cost 500, 100 fakes cost 5000, and a bigger farm draws more hunters. Mirror nodes copy the public Fable ledger so anyone can recheck verdicts, and a marble token marks each cleared identity. Honest users lock once. Limit: attackers with truly separate machines can pass.
